comment: Pinned inputs of lecore-plus-windows-stack.zip. Every download is checked against sha256 at build time; install.ps1 re-checks the payload on the laptop.

msvc_runtime.comment: The llama.cpp Windows binaries import the MSVC runtime (llama-server.exe -> vcruntime140.dll; llama-server-impl.dll, llama.dll, ggml*.dll -> msvcp140.dll, vcruntime140.dll, vcruntime140_1.dll), which the release zip does not carry and a clean Windows 11 install does not have (llama-server exited with 0xC0000135 STATUS_DLL_NOT_FOUND on the golden image's first boot). Shipped app-local next to llama-server.exe (Microsoft's documented app-local deployment of the redistributable files). Taken from Microsoft's current Visual C++ Redistributable (the link always serves the latest version, so it is verified by Microsoft's Authenticode signature, like the ADK, and the version is recorded in manifest.json); the latest runtime is backward compatible with every toolset, including the one llama.cpp's release is built with.

wheels.comment: leCore requirements.txt (flask numpy pillow pytest pytest-xdist matplotlib nltk) resolved for win_amd64 / cp313, plus pip itself so the laptop installs offline with --no-index.

nltk_data.comment: Corpora leCore's code references (holographic_text.ensure_corpora, holographic_ablate, holographic_measure, holographic_schema). Pre-staged so nothing tries to download them; sitecustomize.py also turns nltk.download into an offline no-op.

fido.comment: pbatard/Fido, used only on the CI runner to resolve Microsoft's official Windows 11 ISO link.

adk.comment: Windows ADK 10.1.26100.9457 (September 2026) bootstrapper; only the Deployment Tools feature (oscdimg) is installed. Verified by Microsoft Authenticode signature (the fwlink always serves the current build).

test_model.comment: CI smoke test only. Never shipped.

ci_vulkan.comment: CI smoke test only, never shipped: a software Vulkan device so the shipped llama.cpp Vulkan build is exercised on the runner (which has no GPU). On the laptops the AMD/NVIDIA drivers provide the Vulkan loader and ICD.

loader.name: Khronos Vulkan loader (LunarG Vulkan Runtime 1.4.363.0 components)

icd.name: Mesa 26.2.4 lavapipe (llvmpipe Vulkan), mesa-dist-win MSVC build
